# DiagramCloud

> Local-first project studio that graphs repositories and multi-repository projects from their source (deterministic scanner, per-repository Git revisions) and draws public views as editorial figures. Agents write manifests, design briefs or revision-guarded patches; a person reviews them. Agents never hand-edit documents, invent facts, or present scans or synthetic values as verified results.

## For agents

- [AI guide](docs/AI_GUIDE.md): commands, the formats an agent writes (project manifest, design brief, patch), choosing a figure (including the evidence the Sankey, Gantt and baseline/current comparison need, and the Edit-mode forms that author them), recorded compatibility evidence for a choice, worked flows, and what never to do.
- [Diagram Design skill](skills/diagramcloud-design/SKILL.md): step-by-step skill for graphing a codebase and drawing it.
- [Proposal validator](src/core/proposal.ts): the one check behind the JSON / AI dialog, `npm run intelligence -- validate-proposal` and the MCP `diagramcloud_validate_proposal`; same payload, same reasons (wrong project or revision, replay, no self-review, no provider launch).
- [Contributor rules and current limits](AGENTS.md)

## Reference

- [Document contract](src/core/model.ts): `validateDocument` is the gate; JSON Schema alone is not enough.
- Generated JSON Schema: `npm run generate` writes `public/diagramcloud.schema.json` (structural guidance only)
- [Example design brief](docs/design-brief.example.json)
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md), [Release qualification](docs/RELEASE.md)
